anomalies.observed: On the root sheet the DISPLAY hierarchical sheet symbol's third pin (the SSD1306 SCL line) is labelled NET0002, and NET0002 is the same net that connects J1 pin 2 (SWDIO) to the MCU's SWD pin. The wire from U2 PB14 therefore lands on NET0002. Inside the child display.kicad_sch the SCL line (U3 pin 18, D0) is labelled NET0009, a name that never appears on the root sheet, so the display SCL is not driven and the SWD debug net is instead tied to the MCU pin that should carry DISP_SCL.
anomalies.expected: Per the spec, DISP_SCL is U2 pin 34 (PB13) -> R6 10k to VCC -> U4 pin 18 (D0), and the SWD interface (J1 SWDIO) must stay a separate debug net. The DISPLAY sheet symbol's SCL pin should carry the same net name as the child sheet's SCL (NET0009), not NET0002.

anomalies.impact: The SWDIO debug line is shorted onto the MCU's display-SCL GPIO, and the SSD1306 serial clock (NET0009) is left unconnected, so the OLED cannot be clocked and the SWD port is loaded by an unrelated GPIO; programming/display behaviour diverges from the intended design.
